citation: Tura A, Göbl C, Vardarli I, et al. Insulin clearance and incretin hormones following oral and “isoglycemic” intravenous glucose in type 2 diabetes patients under different antidiabetic treatments. Scientific Reports. 2022.
protocol: 75 g OGTT (day 5) and isoglycaemic IV glucose infusion (day 6) in each of four 6-day treatment periods (metformin, sitagliptin, both, placebo); overnight fast
population: n=20 T2D (16 M, 4 F), age 59+/-2 y (SE), BMI 31+/-1, HbA1c 7.0+/-0.1%; second cohort n=12 T2D (61+/-3 y) with GLP-1/GIP infusions
note: T2D on drugs: use the placebo period only if the paper separates it; Table 1 appears to give OGTT vs IIGI means (basal and mean glucose, insulin, C-peptide, GLP-1, GIP) and whether it is pooled across treatments was not verified. Second cohort (n=12) got GLP-1/GIP infusions.
